name: monster-hunter-outlanders-out-now
lines:
يصل معها سلاح Charge Axe
سيف يتحول إلى فأس

تضم أيضًا وحوشًا جديدة
لم تظهر في السلسلة من قبل
headline:
صدرت للهواتف اليوم
لعبة Monster Hunter
label: متوفر الآن
note: Press release (TiMi Studio Group, quoted on Famitsu 29 Oct 11:33 JST): official service of Monster Hunter Outlanders, developed under licence from Capcom, began 29 Oct 2026; mainland China version 2027 or later; launch trailer debuts the Charge Axe, unlocked at service start; original elder dragon and a unique monster ecology. UAE App Store: free, seller Garena Online, released, no Arabic. Footage: official launch trailer, IGN 3840 copy (17.9 Mbps, decode clean), music-led stretch from 55.5 s (narration only at 17.6-23.3 and 40.8-44.7 s); captioned stretches 52.5-55 and 67.5-71.5 avoided.
